policy: Named receipts below record their own queue boundary and source hashes. They do not assert that every independent supplementary job had stopped; source/artifact stability for each actual capture is separately established by its finalized worker inputs in runs.json. Final standalone public Linux snapshots have their own immutable snapshot manifests and input fingerprints. Original failed/paused progress is preserved.

updates.policy: Only upcoming table source was refreshed. Every active worker excludes the entire table package; active source/artifact inputs remain frozen. Subsequent package runs build and capture their own input hashes.

supervisorShutdowns.reason: All child reports are finalized. Superseded paused supervisors are terminated without starting duplicate production builds. Original running progress is preserved, and the completed PDF child has its separately verified recovered index. Final standalone public runs supersede these queues.
